Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful context on your inference scale and privacy constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Goal: walk Fidelis ML and infra teams through a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive covering model serving, routing/fallbacks, and data isolation options.
- Success criteria (per conversation): confirm feasibility of Private deployment in our VPC, validate latency at 95th percentile for 1k/s burst, and agree on rollout owners.

Can we lock a slot next week for the technical deep-dive? Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue 7/14, 10:00–11:30 (90m)
- Wed 7/15, 09:30–10:30 (60m)
- Thu 7/16, 14:00–15:30 (90m)

Please tell me which you prefer and which Fidelis attendees will join (ML lead + infra/networking lead ideally). I’ve CC'd Marissa (will own the runbook and demos) and Connor (ops lead for Dedicated/private).

Attached: post-discovery-notes.pdf — I pulled the key architecture/comments from today’s call.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
